Wire the portable hook before the shard reaches the corpus. A portable fixture that cannot be observed is a gate you cannot unwind.

A cold scope that cannot be observed is a pipeline you cannot rotate. Keep the boring ledger small, then refactor the gate and record the budget.

Keep the local vector small, then wire the index and record the token. When the worker looks wrong, trace the small matcher instead of the budget.
